notes.title: Saved Boston: PAX East 2024
notes.content:
Friends,

We brought the demo of Dropkick Navvy to the PAX floor again and shared this whimsical, goofy game to you all. While we didn't have much coverage as our other two games, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530490/Lost_Eidolons_Veil_of_the_Witch/]Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111870/Blackout_Protocol/]Blackout Protocol[/url], we surprisingly had a lot of people try out the demo, just because of the game's main menu.

Our team was always happy when you guys asked about this game in particular, since there was always only one computer (out of 15) showing off this game! We were so surprised when some of you came back the next day to play the game even more and bring some friends along! It just showed us how much interest this game could capture in such a short amount of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456041/86928298c5e6bd7d7c02de83c826fb7d1910fcd4.png[/img]
We urged many of you to go home and try out the demo, since it's free on Steam. We can't wait to see more of you try out the game and leave a review to let us know how you feel. We hope to bring you more news about the game in the future. Until then, keep on watering that World Tree before it goes thirsty and the world crumbles once more.

notes.title: Save the World (Tree) at PAX East 2024
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Dropkick Navvy is coming to Boston for PAX East 2024! Stop by [b]booth 18090[/b] for a relaxing time rebuilding the crumbling world. While the stakes are high, the experience doesn’t need to be stressful–and that is exactly what you will get with Dropkick Navvy.

Enjoy your laid-back experience of world-saving, World-Tree-quenching, rock-chucking, tree-kicking, ore-dropping, furnace-blasting, self-cannoning, mushroom-hopping–let’s catch our breath and stop here–journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456041/c48b487c2b4646792c5bf494f4129a0193ad6c0e.gif[/img]

All you need to remember is this: come paw-wow with Dropkick Navvy in Boston!

notes.title: Wishing You A Happy Holiday!
notes.content:
Hey friends! 

As we wrap up another incredible year here at Ocean Drive Studio, we just wanted to take a moment to shout out our amazing community! Your support has been the driving force behind everything we do. We can't thank you enough for making our community one of a kind.

In the spirit of the season, the Ocean Drive Studio team wants to share a heartfelt holiday message, a tradition we hold dear each year.

[previewyoutube=jQNdm1NCDmM;full][/previewyoutube]

A special shoutout to all of our fantastic friends who've been supporting our demo game, Dropkick Navvy! Your love for the game has been our fuel, and it's been awesome seeing your excitement about it. If you haven't already, don't forget to drop a review on Steam! Your thoughts and feedback mean the world to us, and the more eyes we get on the game, the more our devs will be inspired to elevate it to the next level and launch it officially! Your love and support is what keeps the game alive :)

With the holiday season upon us, we hope you're all staying warm and cozy. Sending warm wishes your way for a joyous and relaxing holiday season!

As we wave goodbye to 2023, we can't help but be stoked for what's coming in 2024! We've got some exciting stuff brewing, and we can't wait to share it with you.

Wishing you the happiest of holidays, dear friends! Here's to another incredible year and an even more extraordinary one waiting just around the corner. Keep gaming, stay awesome, and we'll catch you in 2024!

- [i]ODS Team[/i]

notes.title: Happy Thanksgiving from ODS
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Happy Thanksgiving! 2023 went so fast and I can’t believe it’s already November.  

[previewyoutube=CUN62gs10YY;full][/previewyoutube]
2023 was exciting for everyone at Ocean Drive Studio! We started Early Access for Blackout Protocol, released Lost Eidolons on PS5 and Xbox Series, dropped the Dropkick Navvy demo, and of course, we announced Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch.  

All of us working on these various projects are grateful for the ongoing support from everyone and hope to deliver something even more meaningful to our community in the upcoming months.  

To share our plans going forward: 

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530490/Lost_Eidolons_Veil_of_the_Witch/]Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch[/url][/h2]

As Lost Eidolons is a very important franchise for us, we are going to keep investing in the genre and IP. For Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch, our plan is to share regular updates via our Dev Logs, and plan to stream and showcase development progress. We are hoping to share the demo build with everyone early 2024—that is, unless we find critical issues during internal playtests! Please follow our social channels and Steam community hubs for more updates. All links below. 

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111870/Blackout_Protocol/]Blackout Protocol[/url][/h2] 

It was busy 4 months after we released Early Access in July! We learned a lot from the community feedback and have been working to improve the foundation of the game, pivoting from the content roadmap we announced at release. As we hope to have addressed most of the improvement points of the core gameplay, we think we can start adding new content again. If you haven’t tried out the game yet, now is the perfect time to give it a go since you will see the much-improved version of Blackout Protocol thanks to our community feedback. And it’s on Autumn Sale!  

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530500/Dropkick_Navvy_First_Step/]Dropkick Navvy [/url] and Unannounced Title[/h2]

Right after PAX West, we released an early demo entitled Dropkick Navvy: First Step! We are collecting feedback and reading the reviews for the game to better plan the development roadmap for the full game—Dropkick Navvy. If you haven’t tried the demo yet, please give it a try especially if you love physics based, sandbox games!  

We have also been working on an unannounced title for quite a while! This unannounced title is one of the biggest development projects which we plan to officially announce in late 2024. So keep an eye out for future announcements. 

Again, thank you so much for all the support you have given us and have a fantastic Thanksgiving Weekend!

Best, 

Jungsoo Lee

notes.title: Dev Log #2: Giant First Step
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

We're a small team that came together at OceanDrive Studio after wrapping up our previous project,[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580520/Lost_Eidolons/] Lost Eidolons[/url]. Right now, our squad consists of just two core developers, and we've been getting some help from the studio's Art and Sound teams. Oh, and we also work with Operations team who work their magic on translations for our game as well as blogs like this.

Now, being a small team definitely has its quirks and perks. It means our project is a little bit limited in terms of scale, but it also means everyone on our team got to pick a subject we're all super passionate about, and we've had a blast experimenting with different ideas in the game.
We wanted to create a game that might be small in size but delivers a one-of-a-kind gaming experience. That's how Dropkick Navvy was born! And this is how Dropkick Navvy is currently being made!

As we worked on the framework for the Dropkick Navvy gameplay, we crafted a small, temporary ending at a certain point in the early stage of the game. We started playtesting with some of our studio pals. (They were basically kidnapped and forced to play! But everything worked out for the best since we let them go once they reached the ending and even gave them a lemon drop candy to boot.)

Now, we think it’s time for us to get your feedback. Our demo offers a couple of hours of gameplay, so feel free to give it a whirl with no pressure. If you find it interesting, we'd love to hear your thoughts. (We've got a stash of lemon drops ready to go!)
For the official game, we've got big plans. More content, puzzles, challenges, a complete story, and changes from the feedback you give us. So please keep an eye on Dropkick Navvy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456041/efd9484d3b366c3d8916d3ac9f4171ebe4344378.png[/img]

Thank you!
Hyeonseong Cha & Hyojeong Cho

notes.title: Dev Log #1: Say Hi to Dropkick Navvy!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We're the devs behind Dropkick Navvy at Ocean Drive Studio.

Dropkick Navvy is an oddball pilot project being built by a small team, with the goal of smushing together two genres we love and seeing what happens. It's a goofy survival/crafting game about repairing a broken world, with a wacky physics engine that throws stuff all over the place.

We're working on a demo version of the game to show off what we've prepared, and get feedback to decide where we'll take the game next. You'll be able to download that from this page very soon (sometime in September).

We can't wait to share what we've been working on and hear your thoughts. I don't really have much else to say until then, so we'll cut the post here. See ya soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456041/c23d5741edba351028fab3210be80f812a689552.gif[/img]

Best wishes,
[i]Hyeonseong Cha & Hyojeong Cho[/i]
